ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity dominance with a white-to-black ratio approximately 8:1; white pixels occupy the vast majority of the interior ventral surface while black pixels are restricted to a narrow perimeter and terminal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across the central and proximal regions; distinct dark focal spots located in the mid-right lobe and lower-left central region; low-intensity black pigmentation forming a continuous border along the trailing edge and concentrating at the tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped notch with an approximate 130-degree opening angle and low depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks increases significantly towards the terminal tips, creating a jagged, uneven boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory from the median notch that transitions into a sharp, upwardly convex curve reaching the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least six dark circular pixel clusters on the right lobe surface and three smaller clusters near the central notch, consistent with barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions observed in the lower central region, showing a brownish-gray tint against the white background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and extreme jaggedness at the terminal tips, particularly the left tip; multiple dark circular pigment scars distributed across the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, almost-fringed appearance of the distal edges of both lobes compared to the relatively smoother central trailing edge segments.
